Global Metadata: Dark, fast instrumental heavy metal, thrash and modern metal. 176 BPM, E minor, natural minor with harmonic-minor accents. Menacing and relentless from start to finish, built for a high-speed race: tension in the intro, full attack in the main riff, a short breath in the middle, and a louder final return of the hook. Big, loud, modern metal production: tight and punchy, wide stereo guitars, the lead guitar loud and in front.

Vocal Details: Purely instrumental. The screaming lead guitar takes the place of the voice and carries every melody.

Arrangement: A screaming high-gain lead guitar plays a catchy, sinister main riff full of pinch-harmonic squeals and whammy dives; this hook is the heart of the track and keeps coming back. A rhythm guitar drives tight thrash gallops and drops out into long, ominous pauses so the lead can breathe. Fast thrash drums with skank beats, double kick bursts and crashing cymbals. A dark analog synth pad hums low in the background like a distant storm. Intro: synth pad swell and a drum fill into the riff. Main sections: lead hook over thrash gallops. Middle: guitars stop for two bars, only drums and pad, then the riff slams back. Outro: the hook one last time, ending on a ringing low chord.
